row.team_price_text: Team: $137/mo flat billed annually ($149 monthly), 3 admin users
row.evidence: StatusGator's plans page lists "Admin SSO: Secure StatusGator dashboard admin access with SAML SSO" on every plan, but the pricing page, Enterprise page, help centre (search 'scim': "No results found") and API spec never mention SCIM.
row.notes: Status changed from gated to none by absence (medium confidence): the June claim that SCIM is on Enterprise has no first-party source; the Enterprise page lists SAML SSO but not SCIM, and help-centre search for 'scim' returns no results. Pricing moved from /pricing (now 404) to /plans: Free; Starter $72/mo annual ($79 monthly, 1 admin user); Team $137/mo annual ($149, 3 admin users); Corporate $274/mo annual ($299, 10 admin users); Enterprise custom. Team is used as team_plan because Starter allows only one admin user. Admin SAML SSO is now ticked on every plan including Free (June: Team and above). Pricing is flat per plan, so per-user fields are null. The v3 API can only list users; API rate limits run 15-120 req/min by plan.

okta.notes: StatusGator's guide creates a custom SAML 2.0 app in Okta; okta.com/integrations/statusgator/ returned 404.

entra.notes: Custom SAML setup per StatusGator's Azure guide; no Microsoft Learn tutorial found (404).

fallbacks.notes: Okta guide says to assign users in Okta so they can log in through SSO; whether accounts are created on first SAML login is not stated.
